240-3967-5470-8296.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving Yahenni indestructible until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

728-2961-3175.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, False Demise triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning False Demise from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

4050-7388--5.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Rocksteady triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on that creature.
Repeat

2626-2981-4986--44.description:
Activate Megatog by sacrificing the artifact
Activate Salvager of Ruin by sacrificing it, returning the artifact from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Salvager of Ruin from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

341-1594-1621-6867.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Wispweaver Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Wispweaver Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Wispweaver Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

2349-3617-7722.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost.
Thor's second ability triggers, dealing damage to any target.
Resolve Time Walk, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Blink Thor using Mistmeadow Witch.
When Thor enters, it triggers, exiling Time Walk from your graveyard and allowing you to cast it from exile until the end of your next turn.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Time Walk from exile by paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

2103-2974-3942.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a creature spell using Karador this turn.
2103-2974-3942.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Repository Skaab either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying {3}{U}.
When Repository Skaab enters, its exploit ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
Repository Skaab's second ability triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

4499-4747-7297.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Alena.
Activate Alena by tapping it, adding at least {R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may blink any other creature(s) you control.

1661-2511-4871-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
1661-2511-4871-5220.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

628-5147-7187.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Hovel Hurler.
When Hovel Hurler dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability
Repeat.

1274-4365-5086-5183-5231.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
1274-4365-5086-5183-5231.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature token, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 1.

4446-5147-5170-6132.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Cleric
4446-5147-5170-6132.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Relic Vial triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Relic Vial trigger.
Resolve the Relic Vial trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Sceptre of Eternal Glory

1978-4002-4832.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more lands that share a name.
1978-4002-4832.description:
Activate Sceptre of Eternal Glory by tapping it, adding three mana of any color
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Sceptre of Eternal Glory.
Repeat

1680-4508-5184-5880.description:
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

465-3499-3742-4251-5929.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

813-2963-6103-6492.description:
Cast Illusion of Choice by paying {U}, allowing you to decide how each player votes this turn and causing you to draw a a card.
Cast Plea for Power by paying {3}{U}, choosing all votes to be for time, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Teleportation Circle triggers, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Illusion of Choice and Plea for Power from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

1339-4279-6458.easyPrerequisites: Thunder of Unity's second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
1339-4279-6458.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You control at least one additional creature.
1339-4279-6458.description:
Activate Yawgmoth's first ability by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature, causing you to draw a card and allowing you to put a -1/-1 counter on up to one creature.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Thunder of Unity triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it

2060-3693-5231-5544-6431.manaNeeded: {B} if Crystalline Crawler does not have a +1/+1 counter on it
2060-3693-5231-5544-6431.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Forsaken Miner.
If able, activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {B}.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting an opponent or a permanent an opponent controls.
When you commit that crime, Forsaken Miner triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Forsaken Miner from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Forsaken Miner enters the battlefield, Celes's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve the Walking Ballista ability from step 3.
Repeat.

586-2350-2511-5258-5618.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1601-1651-1799-2455-5359.notablePrerequisites: Illuminor Szeras does not have summoning sickness.
1601-1651-1799-2455-5359.description:
Activate Illuminor Szeras by tapping it and sacrificing Threefold Thunderhulk, adding seven {B}.
Activate Reito Sentinel by paying {3}, putting Threefold Thunderhulk on the bottom of your library.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Threefold Thunderhulk from the bottom of your library into your graveyard, then putting it onto the battlefield.
When Threefold Thunderhulk enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating three 1/1 Gnome artifact creature tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Threefold Thunderhulk and a Gnome token, untapping Illuminor Szeras.
Repeat.

413-2281-2757-5006.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one basic Forest.
You control at least one basic Plains.
413-2281-2757-5006.description:
Activate a basic Forest and Plains by tapping them, adding {G}{W}.
Activate Earthcraft twice by tapping Lurrus and Saffi, untapping the basic Forest and Plains.
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Lurrus.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Lurrus.
When Lurrus dies, Saffi triggers, returning Lurrus from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Lurrus enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 4, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Saffi from your graveyard by paying {G}{W}.
When Saffi enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

851-2429-3193.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Olivia deathtouch.
851-2429-3193.description:
Give Olivia deathtouch, if needed.
Activate Olivia's first ability by paying {1}{R}, dealing 1 damage to a creature an opponent controls, destroying it due to Olivia's deathtouch, and putting a +1/+1 counter on Olivia.
When the creature dies, Revel in Riches' first ability triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.
If you have a way to give Olivia deathtouch indefinitely, you may repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

2012-3693-4613.notablePrerequisites: Strangleroot Geist has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
2012-3693-4613.description:
Activate Strangleroot Geist using Walking Ballista's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it.
Repeat step 1 until Strangleroot Geist has no +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve all Strangleroot Geist abilities dealing 1 damage to Strangleroot Geist, and any remaining damage to any target(s).
Strangleroot Geist dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Strangleroot Geist's undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

3783-4300-5147.notablePrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {1}.
3783-4300-5147.description:
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Meloku by paying {1} and returning a land you control to your hand, creating a 1/1 Illusion creature token.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the Illusion token.
When the Illusion dies, Minn's second ability triggers, putting a land from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

608-2584-2677.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Flumph indestructible.
You have a way to deal damage to Flumph.
608-2584-2677.description:
Give Flumph indestructible by any method.
Deal damage to Flumph.
Flumph triggers, causing you and target opponent to draw a card.
Xyris' first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Snake creature token.
The Snake enters the battlefield, triggering Pandemonium, dealing 1 damage to Flumph.
Repeat from step 3.

1251-1550-2105.notablePrerequisites:
Sword of Hearth and Home attached to any creature you control except Combat Celebrant.
An opponent is unable to block Combat Celebrant or the creature with Sword of Hearth and Home attached.
You have not exerted Combat Celebrant this turn.
1251-1550-2105.description:
Declare the creature with Sword of Hearth and Home and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Sword of Hearth and Home attached.
Sword of Hearth and Home triggers, exiling Combat Celebrant, then causing you to search your library for a basic land card, then put the land and Combat Celebrant onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

249-721-1367.manaNeeded: {1}{W/U}{W}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable, on the first turn
249-721-1367.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to kill a creature.
An opponent is unable to block and kill your creatures.
{5}{U}{U} available on each extra turn.
249-721-1367.description:
Activate Scroll of Fate by tapping it, manifesting Nexus of Fate.
Kill Nexus of Fate, causing it to be put into your graveyard.
Cast Zethi kicked once by paying {1}{W/U}{W}{U} and commander tax, if applicable.
Zethi enters the battlefield, exiling Nexus of Fate from your graveyard with a kick counter on it.
During any other turn, declare Zethi as an attacker attacking an opponent unable to block and kill it.
Zethi triggers, causing you to pay {5}{U}{U} to cast a copy of Nexus of Fate.
Resolve the Nexus of Fate copy, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and shuffle your library.
Repeat from step 5 each turn.

2173-4267-4996.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is 6 or higher.
You have another card in hand.
2173-4267-4996.description:
Activate Divining Witch by paying {1}{B}, tapping it and discarding a card, naming a card not in your library and exiling your library.
Cast Beacon of Immortality by paying {5}{W}, doubling your life total and shuffling it into your library.
Cast Beacon of Immortality from the top of your library by paying 6 life, doubling your life total and shuffling it into your library.
Repeat step 3.

220-2615-3432.notablePrerequisites: Tree of Perdition does not have summoning sickness.
220-2615-3432.description:
Activate Tree of Perdition, exchanging target opponent's life total with Tree of Perdition's toughness.
Cast Star of Extinction for {5}{R}{R}, destroying target land and dealing 20 damage to all creatures and planeswalkers.
Brash Taunter triggers, dealing 20 damage to target opponent.
